description:
Cast Tatterkite by paying {3}.
When Tatterkite enters the battlefield, Aether Flash triggers, dealing 2 damage to Tatterkite.
Tatterkite dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Tatterkite's undying ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard with zero +1/+1 counters on it due to its ability.
Repeat from step 2.
NOTE: This combo creates a mandatory infinite loop that will draw the game if it is not interacted with.
